title: MaLanguageLearning
summary: Learn a language by speaking the names of the items you pick up. Requires a large local speech model and has a performance cost — read the warning.
description:
Learn a language by speaking the names of the items you pick up.

When you acquire an item, closing your inventory starts a challenge: you have 15 seconds to say the item's name out loud in the language you are learning. Get it right and the word is learned forever. Fail, and the mod speaks the word to you, then drops the item on the floor.

## !! BIG WARNING — READ BEFORE DOWNLOADING !!

**THIS MOD DOWNLOADS A LARGE SPEECH-RECOGNITION MODEL TO YOUR COMPUTER.**

- **IT IS LARGE.** The int8 Parakeet v3 model is about **670 MB**. Full precision is about **2.5 GB**. With TTS voices the cache reaches roughly **800 MB**, measured. The first run also fetches a small Python runtime and its packages.
- **IT NEEDS EXTRA RAM.** Expect roughly **1–3 GB of system RAM** while recognition is active, on top of Minecraft.
- **IT CAN USE YOUR GPU.** GPU mode (CUDA) is available and **togglable with CPU mode**. GPU mode needs a CUDA-capable GPU and **additional VRAM**.
- **IT HAS A NOTICEABLE PERFORMANCE IMPACT.** Speech recognition runs as a separate local process and consumes CPU or GPU time.
- **IT MAY REQUIRE ADDITIONAL DOWNLOADS.** Models are fetched on demand and cached on disk. You need internet the first time you use a language.
- **IT NEEDS A MICROPHONE.**

Nothing is downloaded and no microphone is touched until you accept the in-game warning on first launch. If you decline, the mod does nothing.

Audio is recorded only while a challenge is active and sent only to a local process on 127.0.0.1. **It never leaves your machine.**

## How it works

The speech engine runs **outside the game** as a local sidecar. The mod provisions it for you on first run — no Python install, no pip commands, no manual model downloads.

- Each item must be said **once**. Once cobblestone is learned it is never asked again.
- Derivatives are separate words: stone slabs, walls and stairs each still have to be said.
- Two translations: a **primary** script (e.g. hiragana, katakana, kanji, romaji or furigana for Japanese) plus a **secondary** rendering (another script, native-language translation, or IPA phonetics).
- Item names come from Minecraft's own official translations, so the vocabulary is the real in-game item name in your target language.

## Languages

**Parakeet v3 (25 languages):** English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Bulgarian, Russian, Ukrainian, Greek, Hungarian, Romanian, Danish, Swedish, Finnish, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese.

**Beyond Parakeet (Whisper backend):** Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Hebrew, Indonesian, Persian, Serbian.

The engine is model-agnostic; backends can be swapped per language.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.3, NeoForge 26.3.0.99+
- **Client-side only** (works in singleplayer and on any server)
- A microphone
- ~1 GB free disk for models
- ~1–3 GB extra RAM while active
